faq_heading: West Newton houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in West Newton. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

West Newton, Surrey: 89 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 8 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 5 of 15 Surrey communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in West Newton fell from 106 in June to 89 in October (−16.0%), and 51 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 8.6% of Surrey’s 1,033 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in West Newton?
West Newton also had 107 condos and townhomes listed and 18 sold in October, against 89 houses listed. The West Newton condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: West Newton home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

84 houses sold in West Newton with a median price of $1,271,500 (the middle half sold between $1,017,500 and $1,483,000), taking a median of 33 days to sell at 95.9% of the last list price; 14% sold above list. They had a median $456 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 6,858 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in West Newton?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 89 houses listed in West Newton. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is West Newton a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in West Newton had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in West Newton from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 51 houses sold in West Newton over those 5 months, out of 464 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in West Newton?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in West Newton sell for?
faq.a: 84 houses sold in West Newton between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,271,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in West Newton?
faq.a: The median was 33 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.9% of the last list price (14% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
